card.title: This browser does not support WebGPU
card.text: This game runs on WebGPU, which this browser does not have. Open it in a current Chrome or Edge (Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, or Android 12 and later), Safari 26 or later (macOS, iOS, iPadOS), or Firefox on Windows or macOS. (navigator.gpu is missing)
